name: Update radar
summary: Which installed plugins have a newer release waiting?
description: Reads the desk runtime state for available releases and lists the plugins with an update waiting, the version gap in each row, and the pending count with its seven-day direction. Nothing is downloaded or installed from this card.
highlights: Pending update count with its seven-day direction
Per-plugin old and new version in a single list
The version gap sits in the row meta, not release notes
